scripts.bundle: npm run build:hook && npm run build:mcp && npm run build:sidecar && tauri build --config src-tauri/tauri.bundle.conf.json
scripts.build:hook: cargo build --release -p grove-hook && mkdir -p src-tauri/binaries && cp ../target/release/grove-hook src-tauri/binaries/grove-hook-$(rustc --print host-tuple)
scripts.build:mcp: cargo build --release -p grove-mcp && mkdir -p src-tauri/binaries && cp ../target/release/grove-mcp src-tauri/binaries/grove-mcp-$(rustc --print host-tuple)
scripts.build:sidecar: npm ci --prefix ../sidecar/claude && npm run build --prefix ../sidecar/claude && mkdir -p src-tauri/binaries && cp ../sidecar/claude/dist/claude-sidecar src-tauri/binaries/claude-sidecar-$(rustc --print host-tuple)
